User.title: User Profile
User.description: Explorer profile for kids with badges and game scores

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: The chosen explorer nickname or display name

photoURL.description: URL to the user avatar image

soundGameScore.description: High score earned in animal sound mystery game

totalExplorations.description: Count of items explored by the user

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated

Favorite.title: Favorite Item
Favorite.description: A bookmarked animal, celestial object, or nature wonder

id.description: Unique identifier for the favorite entry

itemId.description: The ID of the favorited nature/animal entity

title.description: Display name of the favorited item

Discovery.title: Explorer Discovery
Discovery.description: A field note or discovery logged by a child explorer

id.description: Unique identifier for the discovery note

userId.description: The UID of the user who logged the discovery

title.description: Title of the discovery or observation

category.description: Topic of discovery (e.g., Animals, Birds, Night Sky, Weather)

/users/{userId}/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Subcollection of saved favorites for an explorer

/users/{userId}/discoveries/{discoveryId.description: Subcollection of field discoveries logged by an explorer
